_comment: Start-closed starter for regulated environments (law firms, clinics, public bodies). Copy to .werknario/policy.json. With a non-empty allow list the agent may write ONLY these paths; every other path is refused with a clear reason. Widen 'allow' deliberately as you come to trust more folders. Note: approver identity below records intent; it is defined and tested but not yet enforced by the CLI gate, so treat it as documentation, not a control (see docs/permissions.md).
